ck_mfa_credential_shape.name: ck_mfa_credential_shape
ck_mfa_credential_shape.value: case when "mfa_credential"."type" = 'totp' then "mfa_credential"."secret_encrypted" is not null and "mfa_credential"."issuer" is null and "mfa_credential"."external_id" is null else "mfa_credential"."secret_encrypted" is null and "mfa_credential"."issuer" is not null and "mfa_credential"."external_id" is not null end

ck_media_dimensions.name: ck_media_dimensions
ck_media_dimensions.value: ("media"."width" is null) = ("media"."height" is null) and "media"."width" > 0 and "media"."height" > 0

ck_redirect_target.name: ck_redirect_target
ck_redirect_target.value: case when "redirect"."status_code" = 410 then "redirect"."target" is null and "redirect"."content_id" is null else num_nonnulls("redirect"."target", "redirect"."content_id") = 1 end
